patterns: Trailer day for family and TV franchises: 12 trailer/teaser posts drew 16,920,339 views. DiscussingFilm's 'ICE AGE 6: BOILING POINT' trailer led the whole board at 6,935,694, and the INVINCIBLE Season 5 teaser had the day's most likes (111,881 on 4,055,423).

AI-on-screen keeps compounding: two ARTIFICIAL poster posts (Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman) drew 7,895,451 views. DiscussingFilm's did 5,504,660 and FilmUpdates' version was that account's best at 2,390,791.

GTA 6 launch week is still the film feed's side hustle: 11 GTA posts drew 15,774,169 views, and the movie/TV crossover angle (Dexter's apartment, Fast & Furious car, X-Men parody, a Hulk-like creature) put 4 posts at 4,203,426.

Hunger Games release weekend runs on personality, not just numbers: 7 Hunger Games/Jennifer Lawrence/Josh Hutcherson posts drew 1,481,744. FilmUpdates' 'Jennifer Lawrence ranks her on-screen kisses' list (628,739) beat its $21.25M previews post (72,544) by almost 9x.

Small accounts win with nostalgia and one-line framing: ATRightMovies' best was a 1985 dance duet (65,828); CinemaTweets1's 'The Best Show On Television' did 97,564; RottenTomatoes' best was a first look (Day of the Jackal S2, 64,155), not a score post.
Direct questions underperform on the small accounts today: ATRightMovies' audience prompts (Meg Ryan, Adam Driver, DRIVE rating, Mount Rushmore) sat at 14K-18K, below its archival clip posts.
narrative_synthesis: Trailers (Ice Age 6, Invincible S5) and ARTIFICIAL's poster led; GTA 6 crossovers kept gaming in the film feed; Hunger Games opening weekend is driving personality posts more than box office posts. ARTIFICIAL is the best bridge to Cinema's AI books.
